cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The car won't start. Excellent chance for a walk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And a free shower!

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brilliant. The shower's finally reached your feet.

mechanism: A treats worsening weather as increasingly valuable evidence that its pupil is ready for more advanced practical lessons.
confusable: The setbacks become better opportunities rather than being denied or simply greeted with generic happiness.
comparison: Walk after a failed car versus theatre cancellation yielding a mobile performance lesson.
seedUse: Use D20 broken car/rain/leaking shoe chain; S05 field learning interprets observations as progress and substitutes new exercises.
